name: so1_arm_pick_bottle3
prompt:
PHYSICAL SIMULATION: ROBOTIC ARM OBJECT MANIPULATION. 

[SETUP]: The input image shows a SO1 robotic arm with an open gripper positioned near a water bottle on a table. 
[CAMERA STATE]: The camera is STATIC and fixed in position, capturing the motion of the robotic arm. CAMERA VELOCITY = 0. The background table and environment are FROZEN and do not move.
[ACTION VECTOR]: The SO1 robotic arm extends its articulated segments towards the water bottle. The gripper slowly closes around the bottle, grasps it firmly, and lifts it vertically upward in a smooth motion. 
[OUTCOME]: The bottle is securely held by the gripper and moves with the arm as it lifts, with no slipping or falling, demonstrating precise pick-and-place operation.
negative_prompt: human hands, camera movement, shaking, blurred motion, bottle falling, gripper missing, distorted arm, floating objects, changing background, low quality
